resources.string: Documents for your Galaxy Z Fold 8, offline and online
Work on files stored on this phone. No internet or Microsoft account needed.
Microsoft\'s own Word for the web in Chrome. Needs internet. Sign-in, subscription and OneDrive saving are handled by Microsoft.
Delete these unsaved changes? This can\'t be undone.
Fold Word is not made by Microsoft. It never asks for or stores your Microsoft password, and it never uploads your files on its own.
Pick a folder on your phone (for example Documents) where Fold Word keeps your offline documents. Files there stay on your phone even if Fold Word is uninstalled.
No internet. Word Online needs a connection; your offline documents still work.

Uploading puts a separate copy of this file in your OneDrive. After that, the phone copy and the OneDrive copy are independent: changes in one do not appear in the other, so you may end up with two versions.\n\nFold Word never uploads anything on its own. Choose how to upload:
Saving first, then choose OneDrive from the share list.
You have unsaved changes here. Word Online cannot see files on this phone, and Fold Word will not upload them. Save your changes first?
PDF: view only. Fold Word does not edit PDF files.
Fold Word suggests this folder when you save, and lists it under Offline documents. Files here stay on your phone if Fold Word is removed.

• Offline documents never leave your phone unless you choose Share or Upload.
• The offline editor runs inside the app and has no internet access.
• Word Online opens Microsoft's own website in Chrome. Microsoft handles sign-in, subscriptions and OneDrive. Fold Word never sees your password and does not read Microsoft's cookies or pages.
• Fold Word keeps only a list of recently opened file addresses, recovery drafts and backups, all inside the app on this phone.
• No analytics, ads or tracking.
These open Microsoft\'s website in Chrome and need internet.
The tip is back on the home screen.
Save a backup to the phone…
Unsaved changes in every recovery draft will be lost. Saved files are not affected.
Only the list is cleared. The files themselves are not deleted.
Drafts, backups and the recent list are stored inside Fold Word and are removed if you uninstall it. Your saved documents in phone folders are not affected.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. Microsoft Word and OneDrive are trademarks of Microsoft. Fold Word\'s offline document engine is its own code. It uses AndroidX and Material Components for Android (Apache License 2.0).

Word shows its full editor (File, Home, Insert, Layout, References, Review) when Chrome asks for the desktop site. Set it once:

1. Tap Open Word in Chrome below.
2. In Chrome, tap ⋮ (top right).
3. Tick Desktop site. Chrome remembers this for Word.
Add one-tap Word to home screen
Check your home screen for the Word icon.
Your home screen doesn\'t allow this. Long-press the Fold Word icon and drag \"Word\" to the home screen instead.
Opens Word inside this app. Microsoft blocks document editing there, so use Open Word Online to edit.
